Complete [[Rilohn Refuge]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Take the [[Master of Whispers]] to [[Rilohn Refuge (outpost)|Rilohn Refuge]] in [[Kourna]] and defeat the demon in [[Mahnkelon Waterworks]].
* *BONUS* Complete the mission without shutting down the water pumps.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* 300 [[Sunspear rank|Sunspear Promotion Points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
As per the [[Rilohn Refuge#Walkthrough|Rilohn Refuge]] mission.
